description:
About this space
LOOKING FOR SPACE, COMFORT, PRIVACY AND A TOUCH OF LUXURY
The moment you walk through the front door from the expansive front veranda, you understand this home is designed to suit a big family or business visitors. The house offers 4 Bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, 2 lounges, large modern kitchen and dinning area, DSTV , SOLAR AND WATER BACK UP. The pièce de résistance is the living room recessed TV feature wall, while the versatile sunken lounge gives an option to watch different channels.

The space
TWICE THE VALUE; TWICE THE COMFORT; HALF THE PRICE:
THE PLACE COMES WITH FULL SOLAR BACK UP. GAS STOVE BACK UP
This property is 7 minutes drive from the Bulawayo city center.
The kitchen is fully equipped with an oven, a microwave, inbuilt stove and a fridge, a toaster as well as a kettle.
Grey Oak has secure enclosed parking and is very safe with electric fence and electric gate.
Grey Oak has full solar back up, back up gas stove, we are covered in case of power outage.
We have a pump driven water reserve tank in case of water cut.
YOUR STAY WILL INCLUDE
Dining area
Flat-screen TV in the lounge
DSTV in Living room and sunken lounge
SUNKEN LOUNGE with Flat screen TV and alternative channels
Free WiFi
Grey Oak Holiday House is a new facility with everything from building to utensils brand new.
Apartment: sleeps 8 or more by arrangement.

Guest access
Guests are able to access every part of the house.

Other things to note
Grey Oak Holiday House has full solar back up and water tank, 3 big verandas for your relaxation. Neat green pebble garden. Very secure with electric fence.
Grey Oak Holiday House has smart TV with Netflix
